messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "other brands of stomach acid reducers"
set: ["other brands of stomach acid reducers", "stomach acid reducer", "stomach acid medicine", "stomach acid production", "excess stomach acid", "reduces stomach acid production", "neutralize existing stomach acid", "conditions with excessive stomach acid", "conditions involving excess stomach acid", "decreasing the amount of acid the stomach produces", "how much acid the stomach makes", "blocking the acid pump in your stomach", "damage to the esophagus from stomach acid", "generic brands", "signs of stomach bleeding", "high levels of uric acid"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
